build._comment: Phase 1 — install_system_acceptance.py uploads the vendored harness tree (cvs/tests/system_acceptance/src/) to the nodes via SFTP and builds it there. No git clone. Skip this phase if you deploy a prebuilt binary or a container image.
build._comment_install_dir: Staging root on each node; the vendored tree lands here and is built in place (binary ends up at <install_dir>/build/system_acceptance).
build._comment_arches: gfx targets for the static kernels (e.g. ["gfx942"]). Empty = auto-detect via rocminfo on each node.
build._comment_nfs_install: true = upload+build once on the head node (shared filesystem); false = on every node.

system_acceptance._comment_bin_path: Absolute path to the binary on each node. With build-on-node this is <install_dir>/build/system_acceptance; with a prebuilt/container deploy, point it wherever the binary lives.
system_acceptance._comment_policy: Absolute path on the node to the policy CSV (e.g. <install_dir>/policy/mi350_ionic.csv).
system_acceptance._comment_vendor: Optional NIC vendor hint for policy auto-selection (e.g. bnxt_re, ionic). Empty = auto-detect.
